name: price_rule_shared_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: PRICE_RULE_SHARED_20261107 — one price rule, one reader (LQ-20261107-280): market_quote.fresh_price/quote_age_seconds hold the operator rule (Finviz cache when younger than price_stale_after_s, else a fresh broker quote, never a stored print older than 30 min, never yfinance). watchlist_entry_planner._bars refuses a frame whose newest bar is older than 120 h, and shadow_decision_service.gather_facts records the quote it used or states the absence instead of serving a stored print as live_price.
